facts.text: Bastion, originally Sartinaynian, was an industrialized planet located in the Sartinaynian system in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, and was the capital world of the Imperial Remnant, the continuation of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: Bastion, originally Sartinaynian, was an industrialized planet located in the Sartinaynian system in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, and was the capital world of the Imperial Remnant, the continuation of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Its last location remained a closely guarded secret by the time of the Caamas Document Crisis, where the Imperial Remnant was located on Sartinaynian shortly before peace with the New Republic in 19 ABY.

facts.text: In addition to serving as capital of the Imperial Remnant as a whole, Bastion also served as the throne world for the Imperial Moff of the Braxant sector, namely Moff Vilim Disra during the Galactic Civil War, and his successor, Ephin Sarreti, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

facts.text: While Disra had been appointed a Moff by Emperor Palpatine, Sarreti was a young man whom had never even met Palpatine, and was not as enmeshed in Palpatine's prejudices, making him a more popular leader in the progressive, "reformed" Imperial Remnant.

facts.text: The Pellaeon Gardens were the personal gardens of Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon, located in the Imperial Headquarters on Bastion. He enjoyed trimming the plants and keeping them orderly, using them as a euphemism for the New Order.

facts.text: Disra's palace was an ornate palace on Bastion in the capital city Ravelin, originally built for the Moff of the Braxant sector during the days of the Galactic Empire. It was much larger and more luxurious than the typical headquarters of a moff, including ivrooy coral furniture.
